meta_primitives.Core question: What is required, what evidence exists, and what does it actually support?
meta_primitives.What it does: Normalises requirements/evidence; links claims; preserves provenance/custody; tracks contradiction and freshness.
meta_primitives.Reuses: Framework Engine; Evidence Intelligence; Governed Case
meta_primitives.Typical outputs: requirement matrix; evidence table; gap register; provenance ledger
meta_primitives.What it never means: Not certification, a legal ruling or automatic truth declaration.

meta_primitives.Core question: Has anything drifted, contradicted, expired or become unsafe?
meta_primitives.What it does: Maintains expected/actual state, adversarial review, material drift detection and continuous reassessment.
meta_primitives.Reuses: Evidence & Authority Twin; Seraph/Loki challenge; Continuous Assurance
meta_primitives.Typical outputs: drift report; contested state; freshness alert; assurance snapshot
meta_primitives.What it never means: Not an autonomous shutdown or external enforcement action.
meta_primitives.Common buyers: risk; security; QA; AI governance; regulated ops

meta_primitives.What it does: Binds human authority, capability leases, Valinor authorisation and ARDA execution identity to bounded action.
meta_primitives.Reuses: human authority receipts; capability leases; Valinor; ARDA
meta_primitives.What it never means: Not a new kernel and never creates human authority.
meta_primitives.Common buyers: AI agents; regulated ops; release teams; bid/grant owners

meta_primitives.Core question: Can a third party inspect proof of all of the above?
meta_primitives.What it does: Compiles portable tamper-evident architecture, operational, refusal and product proof.
meta_primitives.Reuses: CapitalRoom proof compiler; Twin state; Assurance state
meta_primitives.Typical outputs: manifest; proof room; integrity hashes; redacted evidence package
meta_primitives.What it never means: Not proof of product-market fit or a regulator's approval.
